verses.uthmani: هَلۡ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ حِينٞ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُن شَيۡـٔٗا مَّذۡكُورًا
verses.indopak: هَلْ اَتٰى عَلَى الْاِنْسَانِ حِيْنٌ مِّنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُنْ شَيْـًٔـا مَّذْكُوْرًا
verses.transliteration: ﻿hal ata 'ala alinsani heenun mina alddahri lam yakun shayan mathkooran
verses.saheeh: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
verses.khattab: Is there not a period of time when each human is nothing yet worth mentioning
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Has there [ever] been — there has indeed [been] — for man, Adam, a period of time, forty years, in which he was a thing unmentioned? — he was during this [period] a fashioned in clay and not mentioned; alternatively what is meant by insān, ‘man’, is the generic noun and by hīn, ‘a period of time’, the period of gestation.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya Insan par la mutanahi zamane ka ek waqt aisa bhi guzra hai jab woh koi qabil e zikr cheez na tha

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجٖ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.indopak: اِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ اَمْشَاجٍ ۖ نَّبْتَلِيْهِ فَجَعَلْنٰهُ سَمِيْعًۢا بَصِيْرًا
verses.transliteration: inna khalaqna alinsana min nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi faja'alnahu samee'an baseeran
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
verses.khattab: ˹For˺ indeed, We ˹alone˺ created humans from a drop of mixed fluids, ˹in order˺ to test them, so We made them hear and see
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Verily We created man, the species, from a drop of mixed fluid, [from] a mixture, that is from the [seminal] fluid of the man and the [ovarian] fluid of the woman that have mixed and blended, so that We may test him, trying him with the moral obligations [of religion] (nabtalīhi is either a new sentence [‘We will test him’], or an implied circumstantial qualifier, meaning ‘intending to test him when he is ready’). So We made him, for that [very] reason, hearing, seeing.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne Insan ko ek makhlut nutfey (intermingled sperm) se paida kiya taa-ke uska imtihaan lein aur is garz ke liye humne usey sunne aur dekhne wala banaya

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا هَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرٗا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
verses.indopak: اِنَّا هَدَيْنٰهُ السَّبِيْلَ اِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَّاِمَّا كَفُوْرًا
verses.transliteration: inna hadaynahu alssabeela imma shakiran waimma kafooran
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
verses.khattab: We already showed them the Way, whether they ˹choose to˺ be grateful or ungrateful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Verily We have guided him to the way, We have pointed out to him the path of guidance by sending messengers [to mankind], whether he be grateful, that is to say, [whether he be] a believer, or ungrateful (both [shākiran and kafūran] are circumstantial qualifiers referring to the direct object; in other words, We have pointed out to him in both presupposed states, whether his gratefulness or his unthankfulness; immā is used to list the ‘states’).
verses.romanUrdu: Humne usey rasta dikha diya, khwa shukar karne wala baney ya kufr karne wala

verses.uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَاْ وَأَغۡلَٰلٗا وَسَعِيرًا
verses.indopak: اِنَّاۤ اَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ سَلٰسِلَا۟ وَاَغْلٰلًا وَّسَعِيْرًا
verses.transliteration: inna a'tadna lilkafireena salasila waaghlalan wasa'eeran
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
verses.khattab: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Fire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We have assuredly prepared for the disbelievers chains, with which they are dragged through the Fire, and fetters, around their necks to which the chains will be attached, and a hell-fire, a fire set ablaze, burning fiercely, in which they shall be chastised.
verses.romanUrdu: Kufr karne walon ke liye humne zanjeerein aur tauq (fetters) aur bhadakti hui aag muhaiyya kar rakkhi hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُونَ مِن كَـأۡسٖ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الْاَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُوْنَ مِنْ كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُوْرًا ۚ
verses.transliteration: inna alabrara yashraboona min kasin kana mizajuha kafooran
verses.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,
verses.khattab: Indeed, the virtuous will have a drink ˹of pure wine˺—flavoured with camphor—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly the righteous (abrār is the plural of barr or bārr), namely, the obedient ones, will drink from a cup (ka’s is a vessel for drinking wine and this [wine] will be in it; what is meant is [that they will drink] from ‘wine’, [a case where] the actuality is referred to by the name of the locus [in which it is found]; min, ‘from, is partitive) whose mixture, that with which it is mixed, is camphor;
verses.romanUrdu: Neik log (jannat mein) sharaab ke aisey sagar piyenge jinmein aabey kafoor ki aamezish (mixture) hogi

verses.uthmani: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفۡجِيرٗا
verses.indopak: عَيْنًا يَّشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللّٰهِ يُفَجِّرُوْنَهَا تَفْجِيْرًا
verses.transliteration: 'aynan yashrabu biha 'ibadu allahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran
verses.saheeh: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
verses.khattab: ˹from˺ a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, flowing at their will
verses.jalalayn: ﻿a spring (‘aynan substitutes for kāfūran), containing the scent thereof, from which the servants of God, His friends, drink, making it gush forth plenteously, directing it to wherever they wish of their dwellings.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh ek behta chasma(spring) hoga jiske pani ke saath Allah ke bandey sharaab piyengey aur jahan chahengey ba-sahulat uski shakhein (nikal) lengey

verses.uthmani: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوۡمٗا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسۡتَطِيرٗا
verses.indopak: يُوْفُوْنَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُوْنَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهٗ مُسْتَطِيْرًا
verses.transliteration: yoofoona bialnnathri wayakhafoona yawman kana sharruhu mustateeran
verses.saheeh: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
verses.khattab: They ˹are those who˺ fulfil ˹their˺ vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They fulfil their vows, [pledged] in obedience to God, and fear a day the evil of which will be widespread.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh woh log hongey jo (duniya mein) nazar poori karte hain, aur us din se darte hain jiski aafat har taraf phaili hui hogi

verses.uthmani: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسۡكِينٗا وَيَتِيمٗا وَأَسِيرًا
verses.indopak: وَيُطْعِمُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ عَلٰى حُبِّهٖ مِسْكِيْنًا وَّيَتِيْمًا وَّاَسِيْرًا
verses.transliteration: wayut'imona altta'ama 'ala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseeran
verses.saheeh: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
verses.khattab: and give food—despite their desire for it—to the poor, the orphan, and the captive
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they give food, despite [their] love of it, that is to say, [despite their love] of food and their craving for it, to the needy, the poor, and the orphan, who does not have a father, and the prisoner, meaning the one who has been rightly imprisoned.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Allah ki muhabbat mein miskeen aur yateem aur qaidi ko khana khilate hain

verses.uthmani: إِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِوَجۡهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَلَا شُكُورًا
verses.indopak: اِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِـوَجْهِ اللّٰهِ لَا نُرِيْدُ مِنْكُمْ جَزَاۤءً وَّلَا شُكُوْرًا
verses.transliteration: innama nut'imukum liwajhi allahi la nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukooran
verses.saheeh: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
verses.khattab: ˹saying to themselves,˺ “We feed you only for the sake of Allah, seeking neither reward nor thanks from you
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘We feed you only for the sake of God, seeking His reward. We do not desire any reward from you, nor any thanks: this contains the reason for the giving of the food. Now, do they actually say this, or is it that God knows this [to be true] of them and has thus praised them by [mentioning] it? The two are different opinions [regarding this matter].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unse kehte hain ke (hum tumhein sirf) Allah ki khatir khila rahey hain, hum tumse na koi badla chahte hain na shukriya

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوسٗا قَمۡطَرِيرٗا
verses.indopak: اِنَّا نَخَافُ مِنْ رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوْسًا قَمْطَرِيْرًا
verses.transliteration: inna nakhafu min rabbina yawman 'aboosan qamtareeran
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
verses.khattab: We fear from our Lord a horribly distressful Day.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed we fear from our Lord a day of frowning, one in which faces scowl, in other words, a horrid day to observe on account of its severity, calamitous’, severe in that respect.
verses.romanUrdu: Humey to apne Rubb se us din ke azaab ka khauf lahiq hai jo sakht museebat ka intehayi taweel din hoga

verses.uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمۡ نَضۡرَةٗ وَسُرُورٗا
verses.indopak: فَوَقٰٮهُمُ اللّٰهُ شَرَّ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَ لَقّٰٮهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَّسُرُوْرًا ۚ
verses.transliteration: fawaqahumu allahu sharra thalika alyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasurooran
verses.saheeh: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
verses.khattab: So Allah will deliver them from the horror of that Day, and grant them radiance and joy
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God has therefore shielded them from the evil of that day, and has granted them radiance, fairness and resplendence in their faces, and joy.

wbw.translation: and will cause them to meet

verses.romanUrdu: Pas Allah taala unhein us din ke sharr se bacha lega aur unhein taazgi aur suroor bakshega

verses.uthmani: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةٗ وَحَرِيرٗا
verses.indopak: وَجَزٰٮهُمْ بِمَا صَبَرُوْا جَنَّةً وَّحَرِيْرًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: wajazahum bima sabaroo jannatan wahareeran
verses.saheeh: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
verses.khattab: and reward them for their perseverance with a Garden ˹in Paradise˺ and ˹garments of˺ silk
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And He has rewarded them for their patience, for their steadfastness in refraining from disobedience, with a Garden, into which they are admitted, and silk, which they are given to wear;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unke sabr ke badle mein unhein jannat aur reshmi libas ata karega

verses.uthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيهَا شَمۡسٗا وَلَا زَمۡهَرِيرٗا
verses.indopak: مُّتَّكِـِٕـيْنَ فِيْهَا عَلَى الْاَرَاۤٮِٕكِ ۚ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيْهَا شَمْسًا وَّلَا زَمْهَرِيْرًا ۚ
verses.transliteration: muttakieena feeha 'ala alaraiki la yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareeran
verses.saheeh: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
verses.khattab: There they will be reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches, never seeing scorching heat or bitter cold
verses.jalalayn: ﻿reclining (muttaki’īna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the implicit [verb] udkhilūhā, ‘they are admitted into it’) therein upon couches (arā’ik are beds inside canopies). They will not find (lā yarawna is a second circumstantial qualifier) therein either sun or bitter cold, neither heat nor cold; but it is also said that zamharīr means ‘the moon’, and so, in other words, it [means that it] will be bright without any sun or moon.
verses.romanUrdu: Wahan woh unchey masnadon par takiye lagaye baithey hongey, na unhein dhoop ki garmi satayegi na jaadey ki thirr (bitter cold)

verses.uthmani: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيۡهِمۡ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوفُهَا تَذۡلِيلٗا
verses.indopak: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوْفُهَا تَذْلِيْلًا
verses.transliteration: wadaniyatan 'alayhim thilaluha wathullilat qutoofuha tathleelan
verses.saheeh: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
verses.khattab: The Garden’s shade will be right above them, and its fruit will be made very easy to reach
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And close (dāniyatan is a supplement to the [syntactical] locus of the clause lā yarawna, in other words, [it is a supplement to the import] ghayra rā’īna) over them will be its shades, its trees, and its clusters [of fruits] will hang low, its fruits will brought close, so that they are reached by the one standing, the one sitting or the one lying down.
verses.romanUrdu: Jannat ki chaaon unpar jhuki hui saaya kar rahi hogi,aur uske phal har waqt unke bas mein hongey(ke jis tarah chahey unhein todh lein)

verses.uthmani: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٖ مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖ كَانَتۡ قَوَارِيرَا۠
verses.indopak: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِاٰنِيَةٍ مِّنْ فِضَّةٍ وَّاَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيْرَا۠
verses.transliteration: wayu<u>ta</u>fu 'alayhim bi<u>a</u>niyatin min fi<u>dd</u>atin waakw<u>a</u>bin k<u>a</u>nat qaw<u>a</u>reer<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
verses.khattab: They will be waited on with silver vessels and cups of crystal—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they will be waited upon from all around them, in it, with vessels of silver, and goblets (akwāb are cups without handles) of crystal —
verses.romanUrdu: Unke aagey chandi ke bartan aur sheshey ke pyale gardish karaye ja rahey hongey

verses.uthmani: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةٖ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقۡدِيرٗا
verses.indopak: قَوَارِيْرَا۟مِنْ فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوْهَا تَقْدِيْرًا
verses.transliteration: qawareera min fiddatin qaddarooha taqdeeran
verses.saheeh: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
verses.khattab: crystalline silver, filled precisely as desired
verses.jalalayn: ﻿crystal of silver, that is, they are made of silver which is transparent like crystal — which they, that is, the ones passing around them [in service], have measured in a precise measure, according to the measure required by the one drinking it, neither more nor less, which makes for a most delightful drink.
verses.romanUrdu: Sheshey bhi woh jo chandi ki qisam ke hongey,aur unko (muntazmin-e-jannat nay)theek andazey ke mutabik bhara hoga

verses.uthmani: وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
verses.indopak: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيْهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنْجَبِيْلًا ۚ
verses.transliteration: wayusqawna feeha kasan kana mizajuha zanjabeelan
verses.saheeh: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
verses.khattab: And they will be given a drink ˹of pure wine˺ flavoured with ginger
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they will be given to drink therein a cup, wine, whose mixture, that with which it is mixed, is ginger,

wbw.translation: And they will be given to drink

verses.romanUrdu: Unko wahan aisi sharaab ke jaam pilaye jayenge jis mein soont (ginger) ki aamezish hogi

verses.uthmani: عَيۡنٗا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلۡسَبِيلٗا
verses.indopak: عَيْنًا فِيْهَا تُسَمّٰى سَلْسَبِيْلًا
verses.transliteration: 'aynan feeha tusamma salsabeelan
verses.saheeh: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
verses.khattab: from a spring there, called Salsabîl
verses.jalalayn: ﻿a spring (‘aynan substitutes for zanjabīlan, ‘ginger’) therein named Salsabīl, meaning that its water is like ginger, which the Arabs find very tasteful, [and which is] very palatable for the throat.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh jannat ka ek chasma hoga jisey salsabil kaha jata hai

verses.uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٗا مَّنثُورٗا
verses.indopak: ۞ وَيَطُوْفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُوْنَ ۚ اِذَا رَاَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُـؤْلُـؤًا مَّنْثُوْرًا
verses.transliteration: wayatoofu 'alayhim wildanun mukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum luluan manthooran
verses.saheeh: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
verses.khattab: They will be waited on by eternal youths. If you saw them, you would think they were scattered pearls
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they will be waited upon by immortal youths, [immortally] in the form of youths, never ageing, whom, when you see them you will suppose them, because of their beauty and the way in which they are scattered about [offering] service, to be scattered pearls, [strewn] from their string, or from their shells, in which they are fairer than [when they, the pearls, are] otherwise [not in their shells].
verses.romanUrdu: Unki khidmat ke liye aisey ladke daudte phir rahey hongey jo hamesha ladke hi rahenge.Tum unhein dekho to samjho ke moti(pearls) hai jo bikhair diye gaye hain

verses.uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيۡتَ نَعِيمٗا وَمُلۡكٗا كَبِيرًا
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا رَاَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَاَيْتَ نَعِيْمًا وَّمُلْكًا كَبِيْرًا
verses.transliteration: waitha raayta thamma raayta na'eeman wamulkan kabeeran
verses.saheeh: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
verses.khattab: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when you look there, that is to say, when you begin to look about in Paradise, you will see (ra’ayta is the response to idhā, ‘when’) bliss, that is indescribable, and a great kingdom, vast, without limit.
verses.romanUrdu: Wahan jidhar bhi tum nigah dalogey niyamatein hi niyamatein aur ek badi sultanat ka sar o saman tumhein nazar aayega

verses.uthmani: عَٰلِيَهُمۡ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضۡرٞ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٞ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٖ وَسَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ شَرَابٗا طَهُورًا
verses.indopak: عٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُنْدُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَّاِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَّحُلُّوْۤا اَسَاوِرَ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ ۚ وَسَقٰٮهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُوْرًا
verses.transliteration: 'aliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun waistabraqun wahulloo asawira min fiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran
verses.saheeh: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
verses.khattab: The virtuous will be ˹dressed˺ in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Upon them (‘āliyahum is in the accusative as an adverbial clause, and constitutes the predicate of a subject that will follow; a variant reading has ‘ālīhim as a subject, with what follows as its predicate; the suffixed pronoun [-hum] denotes those persons to whom the supplement refers) will be garments of fine green silk and [heavy] silk brocade (sundus is fine silk and constitutes the outer cushion, while istabraq is coarse silk and constitutes the inner lining; either read thiyābu sundusin khudrun wa’stabraqin or thiyābu sundusin khudrin wa’stabraqun, or thiyābu sundusin khudrun wa’stabraqun, or wa-thiyābu sundusin khudrin wa’stabraqin). And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver — elsewhere it is stated, ‘of gold’, in order to show that they will be adorned with both types at the same time or separately — and their Lord will give them a pure drink to drink (tahūran, ‘pure’, is intended as a hyperbolic qualification of its purity and cleanness, in contrast to the wine of this world).

wbw.translation: and their Lord will give them to drink,

verses.romanUrdu: Unke upar bareek resham ke sabz libas aur atlas o deba ke kapde (rich brocade)hongey, unko chandi ke kangan pehnaye jayenge , aur unka Rubb unko nihayat pakeeza sharaab pilaeyga

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَكَانَ سَعۡيُكُم مَّشۡكُورًا
verses.indopak: اِنَّ هٰذَا كَانَ لَـكُمْ جَزَاۤءً وَّكَانَ سَعْيُكُمْ مَّشْكُوْرًا٪
verses.transliteration: inna hatha kana lakum jazaan wakana sa'yukum mashkooran
verses.saheeh: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
verses.khattab: ˹And they will be told,˺ “All this is surely a reward for you. Your striving has been appreciated.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Verily this, bliss, is a reward for you, and your endeavour has been appreciated’.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh hai tumhari jaza aur tumhari kaar-guzari qabil-e-qadr thehri hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلٗا
verses.indopak: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْاٰنَ تَنْزِيْلًا ۚ
verses.transliteration: inna nahnu nazzalna 'alayka alqurana tanzeelan
verses.saheeh: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
verses.khattab: Indeed, it is We Who have revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ in stages
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly We (nahnu reiterates the subject of innā, ‘assuredly, for the purpose of emphasis; alternatively it is a separating pronoun) have revealed the Qur'an to you as a gradual revelation (tanzīlan is the predicate of inna, ‘assuredly’), in other words, We have divided it into parts instead of not revealing it all at once.
verses.romanUrdu: Aey Nabi, humne hi tumpar yeh Quran thoda thoda karke nazil kiya hai

verses.uthmani: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورٗا
verses.indopak: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ اٰثِمًا اَوْ كَفُوْرًا ۚ
verses.transliteration: faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala tuti' minhum athiman aw kafooran
verses.saheeh: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
verses.khattab: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not yield to any evildoer or ˹staunch˺ disbeliever from among them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So submit patiently to your Lord’s decree, to you to deliver His Message, and do not obey of them, that is, [of] the disbelievers, any sinner or disbeliever, namely, ‘Utba b. Rabī‘a and al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra — both of whom said to the Prophet (s), ‘Abandon this affair of yours!’; it is also possible that what is meant is every sinner or disbeliever, in other words, ‘Do not obey any of these, whichever of the two he may be, in what he may summon you to of sin or disbelief’.
verses.romanUrdu: Lihaza tum apne Rubb ke hukum par sabr karo, aur in mein se kisi badh-amal ya munkir-e-haq ki baat na maano

verses.uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلٗا
verses.indopak: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَّاَصِيْلًا ۚ
verses.transliteration: waothkuri isma rabbika bukratan waaseelan
verses.saheeh: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
verses.khattab: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And mention the Name of your Lord, during prayer, at dawn and with the declining of the sun, that is, at dawn (fajr), noon (zuhr) and in the afternoon (‘asr);
verses.romanUrdu: Apne Rubb ka naam subh-o-shaam yaad karo

verses.uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَٱسۡجُدۡ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلٗا طَوِيلًا
verses.indopak: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهٗ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيْلًا
verses.transliteration: wamina allayli faosjud lahu wasabbihhu laylan taweelan
verses.saheeh: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
verses.khattab: and prostrate before Him during part of the night, and glorify Him long at night
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and prostrate to Him for a portion of the night, that is, at after sunset (maghrib) and at night (‘ishā’), and glorify Him the length of the night: perform supererogatory prayers during it, as mentioned above, for either two thirds, a half or a third of it.
verses.romanUrdu: Raat ko bhi uske huzoor sajda raiz ho, Aur raat ke taveel auqat mein uski tasbeeh karte raho

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمٗا ثَقِيلٗا
verses.indopak: اِنَّ هٰۤؤُلَاۤءِ يُحِبُّوْنَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُوْنَ وَرَاۤءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيْلًا
verses.transliteration: inna haolai yuhibboona al'ajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawman thaqeelan
verses.saheeh: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
verses.khattab: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly these love the transitory [life], this world, and leave behind them a burdensome day, an awful [one], namely, the Day of Resurrection, not working towards it.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh log to jaldi hasil honay wali cheez (duniya ) se muhabbat rakhte hai aur aagey jo bhaari din aane wala hai usey nazar andaz kardetey hain

verses.uthmani: نَّحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَآ أَسۡرَهُمۡ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَآ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيلًا
verses.indopak: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَاۤ اَسْرَهُمْ ۚ وَاِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَاۤ اَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيْلًا
verses.transliteration: nahnu khalaqnahum washadadna asrahum waitha shina baddalna amthalahum tabdeelan
verses.saheeh: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
verses.khattab: It is We Who created them and perfected their ˹physical˺ form. But if We will, We can easily replace them with others
verses.jalalayn: ﻿We created them and made firm their frames, their limbs and their joints, and, whenever We will, We can completely replace them with others like them, in terms of their created form, in place of them, by destroying them (tabdīlan, ‘completely’, is for emphasis; idhā, ‘when’, functions in the sense of in, ‘if’, similar to [where God says in several places], in yasha’ yudhhibkum, If He will, He can take you away [cf. Q. 14:19]; but because He, exalted be He, has not willed this, it has not happened thus far).
verses.romanUrdu: Humne hi inko paida kiya hai aur inke jodh bandh mazboot kiye hai, aur hum jab chahein inki shakalon ko badal kar rakh dein

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا
verses.indopak: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۚ فَمَنْ شَاۤءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰى رَبِّهٖ سَبِيْلًا
verses.transliteration: inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan
verses.saheeh: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
verses.khattab: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord
verses.jalalayn: ﻿This, sūra, is indeed a reminder, an admonition for [all] creatures. Let him who will, then, choose a way to his Lord, a path, through obedience.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh ek nasihat hai,ab jiska jee chahey apne Rubb ki taraf jaane ka rasta ikhtiyar karle

verses.uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا
verses.indopak: وَمَا تَشَاۤءُوْنَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ يَّشَاۤءَ اللّٰهُ ۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيْمًا حَكِيْمًا ۖ
verses.transliteration: wama tashaoona illa an yashaa allahu inna allaha kana 'aleeman hakeeman
verses.saheeh: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
verses.khattab: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺ unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But you will not (tashā’ūna, may also be read yashā’ūna, ‘they will’), choose a way through obedience, unless God wills, this. Assuredly God is ever Knower, of His creatures, Wise, in what He does.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumharey chahne se kuch nahin hota jab tak ke Allah na chachey, yaqeenan Allah bada Aleem-o-Haqeem hai

verses.uthmani: يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمَۢا
verses.indopak: يُّدْخِلُ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ فِىْ رَحْمَتِهٖ ۗ وَالظّٰلِمِيْنَ اَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا اَلِيْمًا٪
verses.transliteration: yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimeena a'adda lahum 'athaban aleeman
verses.saheeh: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
verses.khattab: He admits whoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He admits whomever He will into His mercy, His Paradise, namely, the believers; and as for the evildoers (al-zālimīna is in the accusative because of an implied verb, that is to say, a‘adda, ‘He has prepared’, as explained by [what follows]), He has prepared for them a painful chastisement — these are the disbelievers.
verses.romanUrdu: Apni rehmat mein jisko chahta hai daakhil karta hai, Aur zalimon ke liye usne dardnaak azaab tayyar kar rakkha hai
